overview: Pawspect is a premium, liability-free, subscription-based SaaS 'Sitter Operating System' for independent pet sitters in the United States. Operated by Data Driven Design Group, LLC. It is a software platform only — never a service provider, employer, or gig marketplace.
features: Zero-liability legal framework for Data Driven Design Group, LLC
Comprehensive Terms of Service with indemnification, arbitration, force majeure
GDPR/CCPA compliance with export and anonymization tools
Versioned consent tracking with audit trail
Sitter operating system: booking, invoicing, CRM, analytics, teams
